width_cross_check.register: RULING XX width cross-check (SEND-90): left and right elevation widths that disagree are FLAGGED ON THE PAYLOAD, NEVER AUTO-RESOLVED. It reports the DIFFERENCE MAGNITUDE, never a boolean flag — any 'agree within X' is a chosen threshold, and a boolean either needs a number nobody can justify or fires on every face. Silent-because-INDETERMINATE is distinguishable from silent-because-agreeing. This would have caught the missing chimney: left 32.60 vs right 29.65, three feet apart, on a house XX already knew had equal depths.
